Method of Attack: Phishing campaign using a malicious Microsoft Word document with macros
Macro builds command string to install NetSupport Manager via cmd.exe and batch file
Downloads and installs RAT binary using msiexec from compromised domain
Persistence via PowerShell script adding registry key and backup installation
Checks for Avast or AVG antivirus before proceeding
Sends victim computer name to attacker and cleans up PowerShell scripts
Attack Vector: Phishing email with password-protected NortonLifelock document attachment
Victim enabling macros in Microsoft Word document
Download from compromised domain quickwaysignstx[.]com/view.php with user-agent 'Windows Installer'
Indicators of Compromise: Use of msiexec command with user-agent 'Windows Installer'
